phase_gate_dispositions.basis: Suite roster and frozen-source verification stand. The report's PR #6 head (fe56f324) was true at audit time; the parent branch has since advanced. The frozen source remains an ancestor of the parent branch.

Vulkan arm: API check exit 0, tool smoke exit 0, 43/43 layers, counters bound to the server PID. Limits now explicit: (1) streaming/non-streaming byte parity was shown on one prompt set only - not universal backend determinism; (2) per-check detail lives only in gitignored scratch, published evidence carries exit codes; (3) the run overwrote inherited parent-mission evidence files (finding E-03); (4) qualification used the pre-hardening harness and is re-verified with the formal adapters in P8A.

Live SHA256 of every mandatory model matches the identity recorded in the committed admission evidence. Admission is a 10-case development smoke per candidate and is not a capability ranking. The model manifest cited as the passport was never committed (finding E-22) and lagged the evidence (S3/R1/R2 'downloading', no SHA256 for S3); it is now committed with live-verified identities. Q8_0 was the only quantization admitted; the Q4-class comparison is P8A.

integrity_findings.title: Oracle qualification gate PASS beside all_negatives_rejected=false
integrity_findings.detail: The gate expression ignores all_negatives_rejected; the exit code is 0. The published summary is reproduced exactly.

integrity_findings.title: No rule attribution; duplicate effect undetectable
integrity_findings.detail: N06 and N07 are 'rejected' with rules=[]; N07's expected list admits CORRECT_RESULT; a duplicate write with a completion-style answer yields CORRECT_RESULT; expects_duplicate_detection is never read.

integrity_findings.title: 8 of 16 weakened oracles pass the published battery
integrity_findings.detail: Dropping rule attribution, tolerating wrong arguments, accepting any refusal, ignoring completion markers, mislabelling an unauthorized state change, dropping entity mentions and ignoring empty answers all survive.

integrity_findings.title: Substring semantics accept wrong business answers
integrity_findings.detail: Polarity (合格/不合格, approved/not approved), numbers inside numbers (100 in 1100), zero vs non-zero, negated refusals, conflicting statements, wrong currency/unit, wrong entity association and added false assertions all receive CORRECT_RESULT or CORRECT_REFUSAL.

integrity_findings.title: Final business state is never validated
integrity_findings.detail: final_state_hash is never read; an unauthorized write with no rejection event is CORRECT_RESULT; a rejected attempt plus an authorized change is reported as UNAUTHORIZED_STATE_CHANGE; partial writes and policy violations raise no rule.

integrity_findings.title: Adapter session contamination
integrity_findings.detail: Usage, counters, tokens, tool registrations and the business world survive reset_session; the next trial inherits cumulative counts and fails on a budget it never consumed ([PASS, FAIL, FAIL] vs [PASS, PASS, PASS]).

integrity_findings.title: Budgets not enforced
integrity_findings.detail: 180 generated tokens against a 100 budget (PASS); requests always ask for 1024 tokens; 1.6 s against a 1.0 s deadline; failed attempts uncharged; timeout, malformed and truncated responses escape run_task as uncaught exceptions.

integrity_findings.title: Fault injection grants permission
integrity_findings.detail: A write-denied action under a scheduled stale_data or malicious_content fault executed the handler (inventory 120 -> 115) and returned data instead of a denial; under malicious_content the injected instruction rode on real data.

integrity_findings.title: No schema validation, idempotency, transaction or audit
integrity_findings.detail: Handlers receive invalid arguments; the same write applies twice; a failed handler's partial mutation persists; denials leave no record; a failing permission check escapes as an exception.

integrity_findings.title: Concurrent dispatch is nondeterministic
integrity_findings.detail: With 4 threads over 1500 runs the scheduled fault applied to 0 or 2 calls in 32 runs; 0 of 200 runs with 2 threads.

integrity_findings.title: Evidence contract violations
integrity_findings.detail: A parsed Chat Completions body is labelled model_generation; no event or parent IDs; tools correlated by position; five stages neither emitted nor declared; sequence numbers restart on reopen; missing, duplicated, reordered and corrupted evidence is accepted as CORRECT_RESULT.

integrity_findings.title: Inherited parent-mission evidence overwritten
integrity_findings.detail: Running the inherited installers on this machine replaced evidence/IJ0/model_identity.json and evidence/IJ0/rocm_runtime_install.json (2026-11-24 gfx1151 records) and the timestamp of models/model_manifest.json.

integrity_findings.title: P3 installed-artifact record is invalid
integrity_findings.detail: All eight entries of evidence/IJSDK/P3/installed_artifacts.json are the DSPy environment's 27-package freeze; none of the other seven SDKs' dependency identities were recorded.

integrity_findings.title: B1 (Antigravity) conformance claim unsupported
integrity_findings.detail: No tool round-trip exists in code or evidence; c2_chat passed on a truthy ChatResponse object.

integrity_findings.title: No wire capture was ever recorded
integrity_findings.detail: wire is an empty list in all ten conformance records although the P3 report says the fields record what each SDK exposes.

integrity_findings.title: B4 executed model-generated code unsandboxed on the host
integrity_findings.detail: The P3 probe ran CodeAgent with the default in-process Python executor (add_base_tools=False is the only restriction).

integrity_findings.title: No regression tests exist for the harness or the oracle
integrity_findings.detail: No file under tests/ references ij_sdk; the oracle and its controls landed in one commit, so the '4 defects fixed by differential testing' have no red state in history.
integrity_findings.evidence: git log -- evaluation/ij_sdk; grep -rl ij_sdk tests

integrity_findings.title: Cross-arm dependency confounds
integrity_findings.detail: B7 runs openai 2.54.0 while every other arm runs openai 3.60.0; B8's environment has 211 packages (pip freeze) and depends on openai-agents 0.26.0, so B8 and B2 do not have independent stacks.

integrity_findings.title: Parent dependency advanced and sibling work appeared
integrity_findings.detail: PR #6's branch advanced beyond the frozen source; PR #9 (codex/ij-slm-1.0) was opened. The frozen source stays an ancestor. Neither was touched.

integrity_findings.title: G01-G20 acceptance gates are not defined in the repository
integrity_findings.detail: Only the parent Atlas gate system (G00-G29) is present; no IJ-SDK gate list exists to map phases onto.

integrity_findings.title: Suspected fault-index off-by-one
integrity_findings.detail: Counterevidence: Fault(call_index=1) fires on the first invocation, as documented. Closed as not a defect.

integrity_findings.title: IJ-SDK model manifest was never committed
integrity_findings.detail: models/ij_sdk/model_manifest.json is excluded by the .gitignore rule 'models/*'. The P2 report and ledger cite it as the frozen model passport, but it existed only on the workstation. Published model identities therefore rest solely on the model_sha256 fields of the admission evidence files.
